query:
As a sustainability consultant advising on global ESG reporting strategies, help me compare the most recent versions (as of 2026) of the SEC Climate Disclosure Rule, the EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), and California’s SB-219 climate disclosure legislation across reporting timelines, data verification standards, materiality thresholds, and enforcement mechanisms. Provide a general cross-industry overview, drawing cost estimates from both government reports and reputable industry analyses. Provide:

- A short description of each framework
- A multi-column comparison table covering all dimensions
- Multiple real-world enterprise compliance challenges and cost estimates per framework
- An analysis of strategic implications for multinational enterprises managing overlapping ESG requirements
